name: smwpatches-custom-fade-patch
title: Custom Fade Patch
description:
Allows you to specify which colors fade during the goal point sequence on a per-level basis. Basic usage instructions are included inside the asm file.

Useful for layer 3 BGs that overwrite the default status bar colors (if you use Sprite Status Bar) and for 8BPP BGs that overwrite a lot of sprite colors, as well as the default status bar colors

(See Sprite Status Bar v1.1.0+ for SSB + goal point compatibility)

UPDATE: Now SA-1 and Asar compatible.
